analysis_md:
解答 由极坐标方程可得参数方程

$$\begin{cases}x=a(\theta\cos\theta+\cos^2\theta)\\y=a(\theta\sin\theta+\cos\theta\sin\theta)\end{cases}$$

两边同时对 $\theta$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{d\theta}=a\cos\theta-a\theta\sin\theta-a\theta\sin2\theta，$$

$$\frac{dy}{d\theta}=a\sin\theta+a\theta\cos\theta+a\theta\cos2\theta，$$

可得 $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}=\frac{a(\theta\cos\theta+\sin\theta+\theta\cos2\theta)}{a(\cos\theta-\theta\sin\theta-\theta\sin2\theta)}=\frac{\theta\cos\theta+\sin\theta+\theta\cos2\theta}{\cos\theta-\theta\sin\theta-\theta\sin2\theta}$
